chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to me who said: Musa ibn Ja'far al-Baghdadi narrated to me, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Jumhor, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, on the authority of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever says in every day of Sha'ban seventy times: 'I seek forgiveness of God, who is no god but He, the Beneficent, the Merciful, the Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him,' his name is written in the Clear Horizon. He said: I asked, 'What is the Clear Horizon?' He said: 'A plain before the Throne, in which are rivers, in which are poured from two cups the number of the stars.'

key_terms.أَسْتَغْفَرُ اللَّهَ: I seek forgiveness of God (a formula of repentance)
key_terms.أُفُقٌ مُبِينٌ: Clear Horizon (a spiritual realm or record where names are inscribed)
key_terms.شَعْبَان: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting the specific dhikr seventy times daily in the month of Sha'ban?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration in *Al-Khisal*, highlighting the spiritual significance of the month of Sha'ban through the consistent recitation of a specific istighfar formula. The reward of inscription in 'al-Ufuq al-Mubin' (the Clear Horizon) signifies a prominent place in divine record, metaphorically described as a vast plain before the Throne with rivers flowing, emphasizing the abundance of divine mercy and the high status granted to the believer.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 24-5 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Musa ibn Ja’far al-Baghdady, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Jumhoor, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Abdul Rahman, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzih, on the authority of Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB), “

Whoever says ‘I ask for forgiveness by God - who is the Beneficent the Merciful the Living the Standing - and I repent to Him (‘Istaqfurallah al’lazi la illaha illahuval Rahman ar-Rahim al-Hayel Qayyum va Atubu ellayh’) seventy times on every day of the month of Sha’aban, his name will be recorded on the Clear Horizon. ’”The narrator said, “I asked, ‘What is the Clear Horizon?’ The Imam (MGB) replied, ‘It is a plain in front of the Throne where there are many streams in which is poured as many cups as there are stars.’”
